title: Path of Building Community Fork (Path of Exile 2)
provenance: Reported by akauascarvalho (highball-db#209, 2026-09-25), Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, macOS 26.5, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXMT, msync, Windows 10, version 0.23.1 of the official portable release, rated 5 of 5 after one session. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Not a game: the free build planner for Path of Exile 2, an open-source Windows program from github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding-PoE2 (the official portable release). Listed because PoE2 players run it beside the game and the official release is a verifiable source. The reporter unpacked the portable release in a fresh environment, added the executable to Programs and, on DXMT with msync, reached the build interface and used build import and export, account sign-in, saving and reopening builds, and the built-in updater, all without extra runtimes or DLL changes. Keep game files inside the environment was on. Long sessions were not tested and nothing was measured here.
